reason: The common abbreviation for the United States of America, which Natural Earth's name fields do not carry; its ISO code is USA, so this alias and the code agree.
The common two-letter abbreviation for the United States, which is also its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.
The common abbreviation for the United Kingdom. ISO assigns UK no country (the United Kingdom's alpha-2 code is GB), but UK is reserved for it and is how most data writes it.
Republic of South Africa, the abbreviation South Africa uses in sport and on its vehicles; its ISO code is ZAF.
Éire, Ireland's name in Irish and in its constitution, which Natural Earth's name fields do not carry. Accent-folded, as every key is.
